items.quote: My girlfriend and I came in for two days back-to-back, and yeah, we were a little anxious about how it'd go. That vanished the second we saw Tomasz. Fun to talk to, genuinely passionate, and always has something useful or fascinating to share. Exactly what you want from someone putting permanent marks on you. The tattoos are great!
items.author: Daniel D.

items.quote: I came in with a rough idea and left with something I could never have imagined myself. He listened, asked the right questions, and the result was better than anything I'd seen on a reference board.
